title: OCR & Documents
motto: OCR is a three-stage pipeline — detect text boxes, recognise the characters, then lay them out. Every modern OCR system reorders these stages or merges them.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: OCR is a three-stage pipeline — detect text boxes, recognise the characters, then lay them out. Every modern OCR system reorders these stages or merges them.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Images full of text are everywhere: receipts, invoices, IDs, scanned books, forms, whiteboards, signs, screenshots. Extracting structured data from them — not just the characters, but "this is the total amount" — is one of the highest-value applied-vision problems.
